chapter.heading: The Lord’s Goodness to the FaithfulA Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
I will
praise You with my whole heart;Before the gods I will sing praises to You.

I will
worship toward Your holy temple,And praise Your nameFor Your lovingkindness and Your truth;For You have magnified Your word above all Your name.

In the
day when I cried out, You answered me,And made me bold with strength in my soul.

All the
kings of the earth shall praise You, O Lord,When they hear the words of Your mouth.

Yes, they
shall sing of the ways of the Lord,For great is the glory of the Lord.

Though the
Lord is on high,Yet He regards the lowly;But the proud He knows from afar.

Though I
walk in the midst of trouble, You will revive me;You will stretch out Your handAgainst the wrath of my enemies,And Your right hand will save me.

The Lord
will perfect that which concerns me;Your mercy, O Lord, endures forever;Do not forsake the works of Your hands.
